name: JK Seijo Inbatsu ~Kegareshi Shitai e no Sabaki~
original_name: JK聖女淫罰 ～穢れし肢体への裁き～
source:
“Let the witch trial begin.”
A news report appeared in a sports paper with the headline “A holy woman showed up in 21th-century Japan!” She (Ubukata Rina) has miraculously healed her friend, who had fallen into an incurable disease, by prayer, which caused repercussions.
“No one can bring about a miracle, other than the one and only God, let alone a human, no matter what. If someone did something like that, she must be a witch, not a human.”
The Inquisition decided to hold a witch trial against her.
The executioner is the sole inquisitor, myself (Kurusu Seiya).

Right now, the merciless witch trial against the high school student who's said to have caused the miracle begins.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.digianime.co.jp/redrebel/product/sj/story.html#1]official site[/url]]
translation:
“女巫审判开始吧。”
体育报纸上刊登了一篇新闻报道，标题是“21世纪的日本出现了一位圣女！”她（冲方里奈 饰）通过祈祷，奇迹般地治愈了身患不治之症的朋友，引起了不小的反响。
“无论怎样，除了独一的神之外，没有人能够创造奇迹，更不用说人类了。如果有人做出这样的事，她一定是个女巫，而不是人类。”
宗教裁判所决定对她进行女巫审判。
刽子手是唯一的审判官，我自己（来栖圣哉）。

现在，对据说创造了奇迹的高中生的残酷魔女审判开始了。

[翻译自[url=http://www.digianime.co.jp/redrebel/product/sj/story.html#1]官方网站[/url]]
